---
description: "Use when creating or updating UserStories workflow artifacts, requirement analyses, architecture documents, implementation plans, or test summaries."
applyTo: "UserStories/**/*.md"
---
# Workflow Artifact Guidance

- Preserve exact `US-{id}` identifiers and established terminology.
- Read the complete upstream artifact before producing a dependent artifact.
- Keep generated documents in the matching user-story folder with the established exact filename.
- Existing artifacts require explicit update or regeneration intent; do not silently overwrite them.
- Separate confirmed facts, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and executed evidence.
- Do not modify source story documents unless the active role explicitly allows it.
